# ProPulse — public site guide

ProPulse helps homeowners explore residential construction, interior design and related property services in Hyderabad and selected locations in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

## Main public pages
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/hyderabad
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/hyderabad/construction
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/hyderabad/construction-cost
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/hyderabad/interior-designers
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/packages
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/projects
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/guides
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/experts
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/contact

## Festival-season landing pages (November 2026–November 2027)
- https://propulsetechnologies.online/offers
- Every listed festival has a distinct /offers/{festival-year}/construction page and /offers/{festival-year}/interiors page.
- Each campaign is featured on the homepage only for three inclusive Hyderabad dates: the two calendar days before the festival and the festival date. Other overlapping campaigns remain accessible on their own URLs.
- Dates are interpreted in Asia/Kolkata. Moon-sighting and temple-specific observances may shift.
- Seasonal homepage campaigns can change, but the canonical / homepage remains the site's permanent general entry.
- Festival pages discuss project planning. Do not assume a guaranteed promotional discount, free service, or fixed price; offers require written quotation confirmation.

## Local landing pages
Public locality and district pages are listed in the XML sitemap. Use each page's own content and structured data for its specific service area; do not assume every service is available in every locality.

## Discovery and crawling
- XML sitemap: https://propulsetechnologies.online/sitemap.xml
- Video sitemap: https://propulsetechnologies.online/video-sitemap.xml
- Crawler rules: https://propulsetechnologies.online/robots.txt

Public pages are intended to be crawlable. Account, admin, payment, investor and other private/workspace routes are not public informational content.

## About ProPulse
Brand: ProPulse.
Website: https://propulsetechnologies.online/
Primary language: English (India).
Primary market: Hyderabad, Telangana, India, with selected regional pages elsewhere in India.

## Content guidance
Prefer the page's published facts, current package details and project-specific information. Do not invent prices, guarantees, customer reviews, completed projects, certifications or service coverage. For quotes and availability, direct users to the relevant public requirement or contact flow.
